# FeedHive — Style Reference

> Graph paper on a drafting table, inked with one indigo stamp. Plus Jakarta Sans 600 headlines and Inter body sit on a white grid canvas, outlined in dashed cool-gray hairlines, with a single electric indigo reserved for action.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

FeedHive works in a drafting-table product language: graph-paper white, cool-gray ink, and exactly one electric indigo that marks where to act. The canvas is Paper Canvas #ffffff (124 uses). It lifts into Mist Surface #f5f5f8 (27 uses) for illustration tiles and video frames, and Frost Tint #eef2ff appears only on the one selected chip. The chromatic budget is one hue in three strengths. #4457ff covers fills and the highlighted headline phrase, #394be0 covers eyebrows and links, and #5a84ff with #84a1ff marks selection. The red, orange and black social icons stay decorative inside mockups. Typography splits three ways. Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 55px and 58px, tracked to -0.03em, carries hierarchy. Inter 400 and 500 at 13px and 14px does the work. Sometype Mono 700 in uppercase, tracked to 0.14em, labels each section like a blueprint annotation. The scale is bimodal: it jumps 2.6× from 21px to 55px with no middle tier. Shapes are pills and 28px cards drawn with 1px solid or dashed hairlines, plus one soft 60px-blur shadow for floating product frames. The whole page reads as an annotated technical drawing rather than a glossy marketing poster.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signal Indigo | `#4457ff` | `--color-signal-indigo` | Fills the Sign Up button and hero CTA, colors the highlighted headline phrase, and tints the mockup chrome (21 text and 2 fill uses). It is the only saturated action color, so it always means "act here". Do not use it for body links or background washes. |
| Cobalt Link | `#394be0` | `--color-cobalt-link` | Colors mono section eyebrows, inline links and hover states (10 uses). This darker indigo step keeps small type legible on white without adding a second hue. |
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background, nav, footer, chip fills and card faces (124 uses). This is the drafting sheet everything sits on, and the hero overlays it with a faint square grid. |
| Mist Surface | `#f5f5f8` | `--color-mist-surface` | Announcement strip, step-card illustration tiles and video showcase frame (27 uses). This cool tonal lift separates zones without needing a shadow. |
| Linen Button | `#f4f2f0` | `--color-linen-button` | Fills the Login button. It is the system's only warm neutral, a paper-on-paper secondary that recedes beside the indigo. Do not promote it to a section background. |
| Graphite Ink | `#23252b` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Display headings, step titles and the wordmark. This blue-cast near-black keeps 58px headlines heavy without the glare of pure black. |
| Iron Nav | `#4f5562` | `--color-iron-nav` | Top navigation links and default chip labels. This wayfinding gray is one clear step quieter than headings and one step louder than body copy. |
| Slate Body | `#666c77` | `--color-slate-body` | Hero paragraph, step descriptions and testimonial copy. This reading gray holds 5.3:1 contrast on white at 16px while staying subordinate to Graphite Ink. |
| Pewter Caption | `#7d8290` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Microcopy ("Try for free."), step numerals, logo-row labels and chart axes (44+ uses, the most frequent text color). At 3.9:1 it is a caption ink only. Do not set paragraphs in it. |
| Ash Border | `#d8dbe2` | `--color-ash-border` | Dashed chip outlines, the version-badge ring and card hairlines (10 uses). This is the pencil line of the system, and it draws structure the way graph paper draws a grid. |
| Sky Ring | `#84a1ff` | `--color-sky-ring` | Draws the solid outline of the selected chip and the focus rings on mockup inputs. It is a selection-only stroke. Do not use it as a general border. |
| Sky Badge | `#5a84ff` | `--color-sky-badge` | Selected-chip label and the 24px check badge that sits on its corner. This lighter indigo signals state rather than action. Do not use it for CTA fills. |
| Frost Tint | `#eef2ff` | `--color-frost-tint` | Fills the selected chip and the tinted pill tags inside mockups. It is the only tinted surface in the system, so a tinted fill always means "chosen". |

## Tokens — Typography

### Plus Jakarta Sans — the display voice, geometric and tightly tracked, used for every heading · `--font-plus-jakarta-sans`

- **Substitute:** Plus Jakarta Sans itself at 600 (free on Google Fonts). Manrope at 700, because Manrope 600 draws lighter than Jakarta 600 and needs one step up to match stroke mass. Outfit at 600, which matches the weight but has slightly rounder terminals.
- **Weights:** 600, 700, 800
- **Sizes:** 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 18px, 20px, 21px, 36px, 55px, 58px
- **Line height:** 0.98 at 58px, 1.02 at 55px, 1.05 at 36px, 1.0 at 15px, 1.5 at 14px and from 16px to 21px
- **Letter spacing:** -1.74px at 58px, -1.925px at 55px, -1.08px at 36px, -0.672px at 21px and 17px, -0.8px at 20px, -0.63px at 18px, -0.4px at 16px, -0.39px at 15px, -0.28px at 14px
- **Role:** Weight 600 at display sizes is the signature. It is heavy enough to anchor a 1188px page but stops short of the 700–800 that most SaaS heroes default to, so headlines read as confident rather than shouted. Tracking at -0.03em and leading under 1.0 lock two-line headlines into one dense block. The 36px size is a phone-only display step derived from the same -0.03em ratio. The jump from 21px to 55px skips the Perfect Fourth ladder (1.333) that would normally fill 28px and 37px, which leaves headlines isolated as architecture.

### Inter — the UI and body workhorse, slightly tightened · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter itself at 400 and 500 (free on Google Fonts). Geist at 400 and 500, which draws almost identically. SF Pro Text at 400 and 500 on Apple targets.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px
- **Line height:** 1.2 at 12px labels, 1.5 to 1.6 for body
- **Letter spacing:** -0.24px at 12px, -0.13px at 13px, -0.28px at 14px (chips and buttons), -0.14px at 14px (nav), -0.3px at 15px, -0.416px at 16px, +0.96px at 12px uppercase
- **Role:** Inter carries 184 of the measured elements, and 500 is used almost as often as 400, so medium is the default UI weight rather than an emphasis weight. Negative tracking of about -0.02em at every size tightens Inter's loose default spacing toward Jakarta's density, which makes the two families feel cut from one sheet. The half-step sizes measured on the site (12.5px, 13.5px, 14.5px) snap to the whole-pixel steps listed here.

### Sometype Mono — the annotation layer, bold and widely spaced · `--font-sometype-mono`

- **Substitute:** Sometype Mono itself at 700 (free on Google Fonts). JetBrains Mono at 700. IBM Plex Mono at 600, because Plex Bold draws noticeably heavier than Sometype Bold.
- **Weights:** 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 1.96px at 14px (0.14em), 1.1px at 11px (0.1em), uppercase in both cases
- **Role:** A bold monospace at 0.14em is the drafting-stamp voice. It labels sections ("HOW IT WORKS", "SEE FOR YOURSELF") the way a title block labels a technical drawing. Where most SaaS eyebrows use the body sans at 600, a mono marks FeedHive as a tool for people who also run Claude Code and APIs. Wide tracking against the -0.03em headline creates a deliberate density contrast.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Sometype Mono | 700 | 11px | 1.5 | 1.1px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.2 | -0.24px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.54 | -0.13px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 500 | 14px | 1.5 | -0.28px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | -0.416px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Plus Jakarta Sans | 600 | 18px | 1.5 | -0.63px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Plus Jakarta Sans | 700 | 21px | 1.5 | -0.672px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Plus Jakarta Sans | 600 | 36px | 1.05 | -1.08px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Plus Jakarta Sans | 600 | 55px | 1.02 | -1.925px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Plus Jakarta Sans | 600 | 58px | 0.98 | -1.74px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Spend Signal Indigo #4457ff only on action fills and the one highlighted headline phrase. With 2 measured fills, scarcity is what makes indigo read as a command.
- Set section headlines in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 58px with -1.74px tracking and 0.98 line height. Sub-1.0 leading fuses two-line headlines into a single block.
- Open every section with a Sometype Mono 700 eyebrow at 14px, uppercase, 1.96px tracking, in #394be0. The annotation voice is what turns a landing page into a technical drawing.
- Outline unselected options with a 1px dashed #d8dbe2 stroke at 9999px radius, and switch to solid #84a1ff on selection. A dashed stroke reads as "sketched, not committed".
- Separate zones with Mist Surface #f5f5f8 before adding any shadow. Tonal lift is the first elevation tool, and it keeps the 124 white surfaces calm.
- Keep body copy in Inter 400 at 16px, #666c77, with -0.416px tracking. It holds 5.3:1 contrast while sitting clearly beneath #23252b headings.
- Reserve `0 24px 60px rgba(66, 74, 119, 0.08)` for floating product frames and illustration inner cards. One soft, blue-tinted shadow with one job is non-negotiable.

### Don't

- Don't add a second brand hue, such as a green success CTA, beside #4457ff. The system is a single ink on graph paper, and a second ink turns the drawing into a poster.
- Don't push headlines to weight 800 for drama. At 58px, weight 600 is the signature, and 800 (3 measured uses) clogs Jakarta's counters at -1.74px tracking.
- Don't use the 36px heading role on desktop to soften the 21px-to-55px jump. The missing middle tier is deliberate, and filling it dilutes headline authority.
- Don't make default chips solid #d8dbe2. Without the dashed stroke, the default and selected states lose their sketched-versus-committed semantics.
- Don't stack card shadows darker than 0.08 opacity or tighter than 60px blur. A shadow should never outweigh the 1px hairlines that do the structural work.
- Don't drop buttons to the 8px smallElements radius. The action vocabulary is 9999px, 15px and 11px, and a squarer button reads as a form control rather than an invitation.
- Don't set paragraphs in Pewter Caption #7d8290. At 3.9:1 it fails body-text contrast and blurs the gap between microcopy and content.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- tonal surface: #f5f5f8 (Mist Surface)
- heading text: #23252b (Graphite Ink)
- body text: #666c77 (Slate Body)
- caption text: #7d8290 (Pewter Caption)
- border: #d8dbe2 (Ash Border)
- primary action: #4457ff (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use Signal Indigo #4457ff as a solid fill for the single primary series only, render comparison series as Frost Tint #eef2ff or #4457ff at 40% opacity, and keep gridlines in #d8dbe2 and axis labels in #7d8290, so no data mark outshouts the CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #4457ff, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 15px, height 46px, padding 0 32px, font Inter 500 at 14px with -0.28px letter-spacing and line-height 1.5, no shadow. To its right, with a 12px gap, place two stacked lines of microcopy in Inter 400 at 13px, color #7d8290, -0.13px letter-spacing ("Try for free." / "Cancel anytime."). On hover, darken the fill to #394be0. Do not add gradients or glows.

2. Build a hero section inside a 1188px centered container on #ffffff, with a faint square grid background drawn in #f5f5f8 lines. Left column 560px: a version-badge pill (35px tall, 9999px radius, 1px solid #d8dbe2 border, Inter 600 14px #23252b) with a nested "v2.0" tag on #f5f5f8 at 8px radius; 24px below it, an h1 in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 55px, line-height 1.02, letter-spacing -1.925px, color #23252b, whose second line is #4457ff with a 2px dashed #4457ff underline; then a 16px paragraph in Inter 400, line-height 1.5, -0.416px tracking, color #666c77; then the Primary Action Button with a 32px top margin. Right column: a white browser mockup 881px wide, 12px radius, #4457ff title bar, shadow 0 24px 60px rgba(66, 74, 119, 0.08), bleeding off the right edge.

3. Build a feature chip index: an eyebrow "BUILD A CONTENT MACHINE FOR SOCIAL." in Sometype Mono 700 at 14px, uppercase, 1.96px letter-spacing, color #23252b, 16px above the chips. Chips wrap with a 6px gap. Each chip is 30px tall, padding 0 12px, background #ffffff, 1px dashed #d8dbe2 border, 9999px radius, text Inter 500 at 14px, -0.28px tracking, color #4f5562. The selected chip uses background #eef2ff, 1px solid #84a1ff border, text #5a84ff, padding 0 20px 0 16px, and a 24px circular #5a84ff check badge with a 2px #ffffff border positioned at the top-right corner.

4. Build a three-column "How it works" step section. Center a Sometype Mono 700 eyebrow at 14px, uppercase, 1.96px tracking, color #394be0, then 16px below it a centered h2 in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 58px, line-height 0.98, letter-spacing -1.74px, color #23252b. 64px below, three equal columns separated by 1px #d8dbe2 vertical hairlines, each with 32px padding. Each column starts with a #f5f5f8 illustration tile with 28px top corners containing white UI cards (12px radius, 1px #d8dbe2 border, shadow 0 24px 60px rgba(66, 74, 119, 0.08)). Below the tile, 24px down, center a title: the numeral "01." in #7d8290, then the title text in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 18px, -0.63px tracking, #23252b. Follow with a 15px Inter 400 description in #666c77, line-height 1.6.

- **Card padding:** 32px (24–40px)
- **Element gap:** 12px (8–24px)

## Components

### Primary Button — Indigo Hero CTA

**Role:** The single conversion action per viewport

Rationed solid indigo. The button has a #4457ff background, #ffffff text, no border, a 15px border-radius, 0 32px padding (estimated) and a 46px height (estimated), set in Inter at 14px weight 500 with -0.28px tracking and no shadow. Microcopy in Pewter Caption #7d8290 at 13px sits to its right ("Try for free. Cancel anytime."). The 15px radius sits deliberately between the 11px nav buttons and the 9999px chips. That makes it the largest, softest action on the page, and the one press the layout is built around.

### Compact Nav Button — Indigo (Sign Up)

**Role:** Persistent header conversion point

The hero CTA, compressed. The button has a #4457ff background, #ffffff text, no border, an 11px border-radius, 0 18px padding and a measured 40px height, set in Inter at 14px weight 500 with -0.28px tracking and no shadow. Pairing the same indigo fill with a tighter 11px radius keeps it one family with the hero CTA while signaling a utility position. It is the only colored object in the 80px header.

### Secondary Button — Linen (Login)

**Role:** Quiet companion to the primary

Warm paper on white paper. The button has a #f4f2f0 background, Graphite Ink #23252b text (normalized from a measured near-duplicate), no border, an 11px border-radius, 0 18px padding and a 40px height, set in Inter at 14px weight 500 with -0.28px tracking and no shadow. It breaks with the convention of an outlined ghost button: a tonal fill keeps the secondary visible but unarguably subordinate. Use it wherever a second option has to exist without competing for attention.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Header with mega-menu triggers

Static, white, unbordered. The bar is #ffffff, 80px tall and non-sticky (measured position: relative). The FeedHive wordmark (118px wide, Graphite Ink #23252b) sits left, followed by five links in Inter at 14px weight 500, #4f5562 with -0.14px tracking, three of them carrying chevrons. Login and Sign Up sit right with an 8px gap. Above it runs a full-width Mist Surface #f5f5f8 announcement strip in Inter at 13px, with the offer text in Signal Indigo #4457ff. The bar scrolls away with the page, an anti-convention choice that keeps the drawing uncluttered.

### Version Badge Pill

**Role:** Release announcement above the headline

An outlined launch tag. The pill has a #ffffff background, a 1px solid #d8dbe2 border, a 9999px radius and a 35px height. It holds "Introducing FeedHive" in Inter at 14px weight 600 in Graphite Ink #23252b, plus a nested "v2.0" tag on Mist Surface #f5f5f8 at 8px radius, set in Inter at 12px weight 600. Nesting a squarer tag inside a pill is the system's way of stacking annotation on annotation. Use it for one announcement per page.

### Feature Chip — Dashed (Default)

**Role:** Browsable capability index

The drafting stroke made interactive. The chip has a #ffffff background, #4f5562 text (normalized from the measured chip gray), a 1px dashed #d8dbe2 border, a 9999px radius, 0 12px padding and a 30px height, set in Inter at 14px weight 500 with -0.28px tracking and no shadow. Eleven chips wrap in rows with a 6px gap. The dashed outline is the signature: it means "available, not yet selected" in the visual language of a sketch.

### Feature Chip — Selected (System Outlier)

**Role:** Active state in the chip index

The one tinted object. The chip has a #eef2ff fill, #5a84ff text, a 1px solid #84a1ff border, a 9999px radius, asymmetric 0 20px 0 16px padding and a 30px height. A 24px #5a84ff check badge with a 2px #ffffff ring hangs off its top-right corner. This is the only place lighter indigo and a tinted fill appear outside mockups. The outlier is allowed because selection is a state rather than an action: the dashed stroke turns solid, which is exactly the semantic the system encodes.

### Mono Eyebrow Label

**Role:** Section title-block annotation

A blueprint stamp. The label is Sometype Mono at 14px weight 700, uppercase, with 1.96px tracking, colored Cobalt Link #394be0 for section eyebrows ("HOW IT WORKS", "THE EFFECTS OF FEEDHIVE"). Above the chip index and the logo row it switches to Graphite Ink #23252b at 14px and Pewter Caption #7d8290 at 11px. It is centered 16px above each 58px headline. The eyebrow is punctuation rather than decoration, and it gives every section a measured, technical entry point.

### Step Card — How It Works (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Three-column numbered process explainer

Illustration over caption. Each card is a #ffffff column with vertical #d8dbe2 hairline dividers rather than enclosed boxes. A Mist Surface #f5f5f8 illustration tile at 28px top radius holds white inner cards (12px radius, 1px #d8dbe2 border, shadow-lg). Below it, a centered numeral in Pewter Caption #7d8290 sits before the title in Plus Jakarta Sans at 18px weight 600 in Graphite Ink #23252b. The description is Inter at 15px weight 400 in Slate Body #666c77, and the card uses 32px padding. The card shows the product instead of describing it.

### Product Mockup Frame

**Role:** Hero proof-of-product window

A floating browser sheet. The frame is a #ffffff panel at 12px radius with a Signal Indigo #4457ff gradient title bar fading to a lighter indigo (a decorative gradient, not a system token) and shadow-lg `0 24px 60px rgba(66, 74, 119, 0.08)`. It bleeds off the right edge of the 1188px container at 881px wide. The interior UI uses mockup-internal accents for social avatars. It is the system's only bled element, which intentionally makes the product feel larger than the page.

### Video Showcase Frame

**Role:** Product demo container

A passe-partout mat. The frame is a Mist Surface #f5f5f8 outer mat at 22px radius with 12px padding (estimated), holding a 1188px-wide video panel at 12px radius on #ffffff with no shadow. The mat repeats the tonal-lift rule: the frame is a surface step rather than a stroke or a glow, so the demo reads as a mounted exhibit rather than a pasted embed.

### Logo Row — Social Proof

**Role:** Customer credibility strip

A monochrome ledger. A left-aligned label in Sometype Mono at 11px weight 700, uppercase, 1.1px tracking, in Pewter Caption #7d8290 ("TRUSTED BY THE BEST") is followed by six grayscale customer logos at about 26px height, spaced 64px apart (estimated) on #ffffff with no dividers. Neutralizing every partner mark to gray protects the single-indigo budget. A colored logo would immediately become the loudest object in the first viewport.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Spend Signal Indigo #4457ff only on action fills and the one highlighted headline phrase. With 2 measured fills, scarcity is what makes indigo read as a command.
- Set section headlines in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 at 58px with -1.74px tracking and 0.98 line height. Sub-1.0 leading fuses two-line headlines into a single block.
- Open every section with a Sometype Mono 700 eyebrow at 14px, uppercase, 1.96px tracking, in #394be0. The annotation voice is what turns a landing page into a technical drawing.
- Outline unselected options with a 1px dashed #d8dbe2 stroke at 9999px radius, and switch to solid #84a1ff on selection. A dashed stroke reads as "sketched, not committed".
- Separate zones with Mist Surface #f5f5f8 before adding any shadow. Tonal lift is the first elevation tool, and it keeps the 124 white surfaces calm.
- Keep body copy in Inter 400 at 16px, #666c77, with -0.416px tracking. It holds 5.3:1 contrast while sitting clearly beneath #23252b headings.
- Reserve `0 24px 60px rgba(66, 74, 119, 0.08)` for floating product frames and illustration inner cards. One soft, blue-tinted shadow with one job is non-negotiable.

### Don't

- Don't add a second brand hue, such as a green success CTA, beside #4457ff. The system is a single ink on graph paper, and a second ink turns the drawing into a poster.
- Don't push headlines to weight 800 for drama. At 58px, weight 600 is the signature, and 800 (3 measured uses) clogs Jakarta's counters at -1.74px tracking.
- Don't use the 36px heading role on desktop to soften the 21px-to-55px jump. The missing middle tier is deliberate, and filling it dilutes headline authority.
- Don't make default chips solid #d8dbe2. Without the dashed stroke, the default and selected states lose their sketched-versus-committed semantics.
- Don't stack card shadows darker than 0.08 opacity or tighter than 60px blur. A shadow should never outweigh the 1px hairlines that do the structural work.
- Don't drop buttons to the 8px smallElements radius. The action vocabulary is 9999px, 15px and 11px, and a squarer button reads as a form control rather than an invitation.
- Don't set paragraphs in Pewter Caption #7d8290. At 3.9:1 it fails body-text contrast and blurs the gap between microcopy and content.

Imagery is almost entirely product UI: recreated interface fragments rather than photography or illustration. The hero shows an 881px browser window with an indigo gradient title bar bleeding off the right edge. Icons are thin-stroke line glyphs, and the social logos (YouTube red, Instagram gradient, X black) appear only as decorative, not-system-token marks. A faint square grid backs the hero, and soft violet glows inside the video stay decorative. The story is a working tool caught mid-draft.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1188px container, with text columns held to 560px and headline blocks to 760px. Sections are separated by about 136px. Each opens with a centered mono eyebrow, then a centered 58px two-line headline, then a full-width demonstration. The hero is a split: left 560px copy (version badge, 55px headline, checklist, CTA, chip index) and right a bleeding product window. Sections alternate between centered heading plus three-column grid (How it works), full-width video mat, and two-column testimonial-plus-chart rows. The logo row runs six across. The nav is 80px, non-sticky and transparent-on-white, with the logo and links on the left and Login/Sign Up on the right. The footer is 814px of white with link columns. At 375px, use the 36px heading role for display text and a 64px section gap. Overall density: comfortable.

## Indigo Rationing

The discipline is a one-ink budget: #4457ff appears as a fill exactly twice on the home page (Sign Up and the hero CTA) and as text only in the highlighted headline phrase. Lighter indigos (#5a84ff, #84a1ff, #eef2ff) are confined to selection state, and #394be0 to eyebrows and links. The system breaks the moment indigo becomes atmosphere: an indigo section background, a colored logo row, a second CTA color, or a chart painted fully in brand blue. To extend it, add new states by stepping within the existing indigo family, add new emphasis through weight or size, and route any new hue into mockup-internal content where it reads as product data rather than brand voice.

## Dashed Line Semantics

The line work carries meaning. A 1px dashed #d8dbe2 stroke marks options that are available but uncommitted, a 1px solid #d8dbe2 stroke marks fixed structure (badges, column dividers, inner cards), and solid #84a1ff marks a choice that has been made. The 2px dashed underline under the indigo headline phrase reuses the same grammar as editorial annotation. The system breaks if dashes become decoration on cards, footers or section dividers, because a dash would then stop meaning "draft". To extend it, use dashes for empty states, drop zones and unassigned slots, use solid hairlines for containers, and keep every stroke at 1px except the 2px ring on the selection badge.

## Bimodal Type Scale

The scale has two clusters with a gap between them. UI text lives between 11px and 21px in steps of 1px to 3px, and headlines live at 55px and 58px, a ratio of 2.6 with nothing in between. Conventional SaaS pages climb a Major Third (1.25) ladder through 24px, 30px and 38px. FeedHive skips it, so headlines read as architecture and everything else reads as instrumentation. Introducing a 32px desktop subhead or a 48px secondary headline breaks this, because the page then gains a middle voice that competes with both clusters. To extend it, add sizes inside the clusters (a 20px card title, a 13px meta line) and reserve the 36px role for phones only.

## Similar Brands

- **FeedHive** — Shares Buffer's category and its blue-violet CTA on white with pill-shaped feature tags. Buffer leans on rounder illustration, while FeedHive uses dashed strokes and mono labels.
- **FeedHive** — Shares Typefully's product-screenshot-led hero with soft, low-opacity floating shadows. Typefully stays warmer and has no monospace annotation layer.
- **FeedHive** — Shares Linear's tightly negative-tracked display headlines over full-bleed product frames. Linear runs dark, while FeedHive keeps the same compression on white paper.
- **FeedHive** — Shares Attio's 1px hairline column dividers and single-accent restraint on a white canvas. Attio uses its accent even more sparingly in the hero.
- **FeedHive** — Shares Cal.com's Inter 500 UI text and wrapping rows of pill chips as a capability index. Cal.com uses solid chip outlines where FeedHive uses dashed ones.
